description: This Java class defines an entity named Contract in a JPA/Hibernate context, representing a contractual agreement with properties such as ID, title, filename, creation date, acceptance status, associated users (author and acceptedBy), client, and value.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: Entity class representing a contract with relational mappings to User and Client entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Getter for the contract's unique identifier.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Getter for the filename associated with the contract.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Getter for the author User object.

methods.name: getAcceptedBy
methods.description: Getter for the User who accepted the contract.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Getter for the monetary value of the contract.
